name: A Tulsa street

place_source.title: Wikidata: Tulsa (Q44989), coordinate location and elevation above sea level

blurb: A residential street in Tulsa, Oklahoma: lawns and mature oaks along the sidewalk, redbuds and dogwoods in the yards, grackles and mockingbirds on the wires, and fox squirrels and opossums after dark.

facts.text: Tulsa has a temperate climate of the humid subtropical variety (Koppen Cfa) with a yearly average temperature of 61.3 F (16.3 C) and just under 41 inches of precipitation a year.

source.title: Wikipedia: Tulsa, Oklahoma
source.attribution: Wikipedia contributors, "Tulsa, Oklahoma", English Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0

facts.text: Tulsa is situated on the Arkansas River in the western foothills of the Ozark Mountains, in a region of Oklahoma known as Green Country.

source.title: Wikipedia: Tulsa, Oklahoma
source.attribution: Wikipedia contributors, "Tulsa, Oklahoma", English Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0

facts.text: The scissor-tailed flycatcher, a common summer bird in the open country around Tulsa, is the state bird of Oklahoma.

source.title: Wikipedia: Scissor-tailed flycatcher
source.attribution: Wikipedia contributors, "Scissor-tailed flycatcher", English Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0

facts.text: Tulsa lies at an elevation of 223 metres above sea level.
